meta.title: Siaya County agriculture, livestock, fisheries and irrigation (printed values by source)
meta.rule: Values are printed values with the raw string kept. Targets and projections are never observed values. Each source is a separate vintage; nothing is overwritten. Gaps are listed, never filled. Yields are recorded only where a source prints them; none of the acquired sources does, so no yield is derived. Sector GCP (value added) lives in data/siaya-economy.json and is not repeated here.

definitions.status: observed = reported as achieved or measured; target = plan target or key output; projection = forecast
definitions.confidence: 5 clean official table; 4 clean table, provisional or departmental; 3 plan baseline or single statement without a cited table; 2 text claim contradicted elsewhere in the same document; 1 unit or magnitude unreliable as printed (do not chart)
definitions.printed_page: page number printed on the page
definitions.provisional: true where the source marks the figure * Provisional
definitions.bags: bag count as printed; bag weight not stated

conflicts.note: Same plan gives 680 ha (p.20, "currently") and 1,000.5 acres (p.177, 2022 baseline). 1,000.5 acres is about 405 ha. Not reconciled; show both.
Table 6.2 gives 28,222 t (2013) and 27,141 t (2014); Table 6.3 gives 24,703 t and 28,519 t on the same page. Both from the county Department of Fisheries. Coverage difference not explained.

conflicts.topic: Maize, beans, sorghum production units, 2015 abstract
conflicts.note: Table 4.2 2013 tonnes do not match Table 4.5 bags at 90 kg (maize 129,818 t vs 1,286,755 bags = 115,808 t at 90 kg; sorghum 22,587 t vs 159,533 bags; beans 20,262 t vs 363,906 bags). The Table 4.2 2014* "tonnes" equal the Table 4.5 bag counts, so that column is bags mislabelled. Bag weight not stated.

Three statements: "30,147,600 metric tonnes per annum" (p.20), capture 30,000 and culture 147.6 under "000 (MT)" (p.23), capture 29,625,057 kg in 2022 (p.178). Units are inconsistent; magnitude about 30,000 t is consistent with the 2015 abstract (27,141-28,519 t in 2014).
p.20 says 88 fish landing sites and, in the next paragraph, "over 60 existing beaches". No frame-survey count acquired to compare.
Abstract: 22,587 t (2013). CIDP review: 25,087 under "000 (MT)" for 2018-2022 with no year. Not comparable until the CIDP unit and period are confirmed.
